messages:
cass_marketing: Kicking off a small pricing experiment next week: rename packages to clearer slabs, add an inline cost estimator, and tighten the FAQ copy. Aim is to reduce hesitation and route higher-intent estimates to sales.

ben_growth: What primary metric are we optimizing?

cass_marketing: Demo-requests from /pricing (baseline 1.7%) -> target 2.8% within 30 days. Secondary: fewer billing questions to support.

anya_product: Naming suggestion: "Sandbox (trial)", "Collaborate (shared)", "Committed (SLA)". Each gets a one-line clarifier and an icon badge for VPC/SLA. Avoid classic Pro/Enterprise labels.

miles_design: I'll make two comps: vertical slabs and horizontal cards. Estimator will be a small widget under slabs, collapses on mobile.

noah_eng: Estimator logic: monthly_tokens * tier_rate_per_1k + optional private deployment fee. We'll emit events: estimator_open, estimator_change, estimator_submit, estimator_priority.

rita_sales: Routing: if estimator selects Committed AND priority checkbox true -> create SFDC lead with tag pricing_estimate_committed and lead_score=70. Include est_monthly_usd and utm. Also add suggested playbook note: "Interested in SLA/VPC".

sam_cs: I'll write a 2-line FAQ blurb for billing cadence and cancellation, plus a short reply template for incoming questions.

ben_growth: A/B details? full page swap or incremental?

cass_marketing: 50/50: control = current page; variant = slabs + estimator + tightened FAQ. Run for 4 weeks or until 6k visits. Primary KPI = demo_CTR. Secondary = estimator_use_rate and sales-accepted leads.

miles_design: Tooltip copy draft: "Estimates are ballpark. Token costs only. Excludes egress & optional private infra fees. Check box for contract pricing and we'll route to sales."

noah_eng: Implementation note: webhook to /integrations/lead-ingest with retries. Ops_bot: please reserve deploy window.

ops_bot: Reminder: Experiment "pricing-prism-estimator" scheduled for 2026-09-01 08:00 UTC. CI window 06:00-08:00 UTC.

rita_sales: Can we add a webinar opt-in on the estimator results for people picking Committed? We'll run a short "Cost vs Latency" webinar for those folks.

cass_marketing: yes add webinar opt-in. we'll follow up with benchmark narrative about batching and KV cache benefits.

sam_cs: once live I'll prepare quick links to enterprise docs and a short onboarding checklist for AE.

ben_growth: i'll add tracking events and a Looker slice segmented by utm_campaign and geo.

cass_marketing: Action list: miles comps, cass final copy, noah webhook + events, ben tracking, sam support replies, rita webinar flow. Smoke test day-before-launch. :rocket:
